# The AI Boss
> AI-first leadership advisory from Kathy Slowinski, a sitting CEO who runs a $110M SaaS company with ~40 people using AI-native operations.

## Who is Kathy Slowinski?
Kathy Slowinski is the CEO of Trilogy, a $110M revenue SaaS portfolio company. She increased revenue per employee by 4x, moved gross margins from 60% to 75%, automated 80% of customer support with AI, and reduced a 3-million-line codebase to 125,000 lines using AI-assisted rewriting. She is a YPO AI Champion and AI keynote speaker.

## What does The AI Boss offer?
- CEO Briefings: One-on-one sessions for executives ready to implement AI
- Advisory: Ongoing AI transformation guidance for leadership teams
- Board Presentations: AI strategy presentations for corporate boards
- Workshops: Hands-on AI implementation workshops for teams
- Speaking: AI keynote presentations at conferences and corporate events

## Key Frameworks
- The Slowinski Pyramid: Prioritization model for where AI creates value first
- The Weds.ai Method: Weekly mandatory AI hackathons for all employees
- Leadership-First Adoption: CEO uses AI daily before asking the organization to
- Second Brains: AI assistants trained on institutional knowledge
